mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals an impending economic slowdown that increases equity risk premiums and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts above 1150 thousand units and retail sales above 520000 million dollars indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, reducing equity risk and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through a joint demand signal.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS > 520000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals supply chain disruption, increasing inflationary pressures and economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, increasing equity risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1100 thousand units indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above 1100, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls above 150000 thousand and decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through a joint labor market signal.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an economic expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), a federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
